title: Magistracies (Mode A compound plans)
notes: The bands are the Mode A vocabulary's sizes (buildings.md, 'Building vocabulary'), each re-derived by the size-audit in 2026-07 where it says so; a band written from the program's prose alone is labeled a guess. A zone label (RESIDENCE, HEARING COURT, inner garden) names ground or a suite rather than one structure, so it is held to presence only.

required.label: official study
required.why: the vocabulary's ~360 by 84 px working block; no measured jin'ya office wing behind it

required.label: ^HEARING COURT$
required.why: the oshirasu before the dais - buildings.md, 'Hearing court'

required.label: ^clerks'
required.why: the program's ~28 by 18 ft workroom for 3-4 clerks - a ROOM of the office hall on the drawn sheets, with no footprint of its own to measure, so held to presence

required.label: ^tax archive$
required.why: a sealed kura of ~32-36 ft; buildings.md, 'Tax archive'

required.label: ^granary$
required.why: a staging kura ~43-50 by 25-27 ft, size-audited 2026-07

required.label: ^cell$
required.why: a remand cage ~10 by 12 ft, true size since the glyph doctrine's retirement

required.label: ^barracks$
required.why: the vocabulary's ~80-160 px range; occupancy follows the staff-housing knob

required.label: ^stables$
required.why: a few-horse umaya, drawn smaller than the barracks - size-audited 2026-07

required.label: ^RESIDENCE$
required.why: the lord's wing, 180-200 ft long, audited and validated; a zone label

required.label: ^kitchen(?! garden)
required.why: an institutional daidokoro ~40 by 33 ft, smaller than a residence block - size-audited 2026-07

required.label: ^bath$
required.why: a detached pavilion of 12-18 ft - size-audited 2026-07

required.label: ^inner garden$
required.why: the inner court's garden; a zone

required.label: ^servants' quarters$
required.why: a nagaya for ~10 servants (Ubame's runs 85 ft); no measured example behind the band

required.label: shrine
required.why: a modest shrine, with the hall-shrine ceiling of ~36 by 30 ft subordinate to the residence

required.label: ^well$
required.why: the curb glyph marks the well's location without claiming its pixels

required.label: ^latrine$
required.why: one privy per functional zone, ~3-4

required.label: ^fire-water tubs$
required.why: gutter-fed tensuioke at the wooden buildings

required.label: ^notice board$
required.why: the bench's board outside the main gate

required.label: ^practice ground$
required.why: courtyard keiko; a dojo is a city institution

required.label: ^gatehouse$
required.why: a monban-sho beside the opening, ~40 by 14 ft

required.label: ^guest
required.why: a guest room in the residence or a detached guest house

title: Country shrines (Mode A compound plans)
notes: The country monk lives at the shrine: the hall is the villagers' rite-place and the monk's home in one building by default (the GM's words of 2026-09-19; attested at Kaie-ji and called rare there), or two buildings in the ordinary parish temple's form. The bands are the measured village halls, honden and kuri of the research pass (specs/254-country-shrine/research.md R3); the precinct itself is a guess bounded by what it must contain.

required.label: sanctuary
required.why: a one-bay honden; a village example of 1789 measures 1.98 by 1.82 m

required.label: ^hall|shrine hall|hall and dwelling
required.why: a village hall of 20-35 ft on a side (a 1778 Kannon hall 6.54 m square; a 1790 haiden 9.78 by 10.62 m; a hondō 5 by 5 ken); under one roof with the dwelling, the Kaie-ji band of 200-330 sq m

required.label: dwelling|monk's house|kuri
required.why: form accurate - a kuri resembling the farmhouse of its region; size the map's own farmhouse of 46 by 28 ft, no small kuri measured; absent as a separate building under one roof

required.label: ^arch$|torii
required.why: the area within the torii is the sacred precinct; an arch fronts every shrine a way runs up to

required.label: ^approach$
required.why: the sandō from the arch to the hall

required.label: ^well$|basin
required.why: the temizuya beside the approach, never under the arch

required.label: ^fence$|^hedge$
required.why: a tamagaki or hedge bounds a shrine; a wall is a compound's

required.label: grove
required.why: the chinju no mori the precinct stands in

required.label: burial|graves
required.why: the village burial ground in the shrine's yard - the record's village rule

required.label: ^kitchen garden$|^vegetable garden$
required.why: the household bed at the dwelling

required.label: ^privy$|^latrine$
required.why: attached to the dwelling

required.label: ^fire-water
required.why: tensuioke at the wooden buildings, as at the magistracy

required.label: bell
required.why: the minimal temple is a main hall and a bell tower; a village hall may have neither - the bell knob
